why_this_file_exists: The prefix holds the whole country twice: 17 objects at province granularity and 255 at district granularity, and the object names (30563-N.zip) say nothing about which is which. Loading both would double every parcel. The district set is the one to load, because it is the finer grain and it is what silver.parcel_boundaries already holds. It also holds every edition the prefix carries, each with its own objects: the provider reuses file numbers across editions, so an object name alone does not say which edition it is.
consistency_check: The set of leading two digits across the 255 district codes equals the set of 17 province codes exactly, which is what makes them two coverings of one country rather than two different datasets. It holds per edition.
snapshot_id_reason: An edition loads into silver.parcel_boundaries as source_snapshot_id = snapshot_id_prefix + edition, and valid_from_utc = the first instant of its provider base month (vworld_parcel_editions.py). Both were typed by hand per run, which is how the same June data was written as vworldkr__parcel-202606 and the September data as vworldkr__parcel:202609 (root ADR-0131, ADR-0148).

new_edition_bounds.$comment: How far a proposed edition may differ from the edition before it before the proposal is refused as a partial collection (vworld_parcel_editions.propose, root ADR-0148 §6). Its 시군구 objects must cover the previous edition's 시도, except where 시도 merge: a 시도 may leave only while another appears, and at most max_sido_set_difference 시도 codes may differ in all (2026-07: 29 and 46 left, 12 appeared, 3). Its 시군구 count may differ by at most max_sigungu_count_change_share of the previous count (202606 → 202609: 255 → 256). A half-updated provider listing fails both.

served_edition_reason: The edition the map, the parcel catalog projection, the PostGIS mirror, the parcel panel Gold and the 시군구 crosswalk's cadastral 시도 are built from. Other editions are evidence (the legal-dong pairing reads two of them) until a reviewed change moves this value.
handoff_suffix_reason: The converter names the object and the loader must derive the same name, so the suffix is here rather than spelled in both scripts. `.gz` also tells the converter to compress and tells Spark to decompress — one string decides both, because two would eventually disagree and produce a file the reader cannot open. Measured 2026-08-31: gzip leaves 20% of a 625 MB national parcel handoff, and the conversion is bound by wire speed.
handoff_prefix_reason: Where the converted handoff objects live. It was a default in three callers — the exporter that writes them, the batch loader that reads them, and the catalog projection command — so renaming the prefix meant editing three files and any one of them missed would have looked in a place nothing was written to. Each edition names its own: 202609 handoffs written on 2026-09-27 by hand under the 202606 prefix carry another snapshot id, and a loader that found them there would skip the conversion and load them.

202606.how_measured: Each object's ZIP central directory was read by ranged request — a few kilobytes out of 12.1 GB — and the region code taken from the .shp member name (LSMD_CONT_LDREG_<code>_<yyyymm>). Extraction dates are the newest member timestamp in each ZIP's central directory, read the same way on 2026-10-05.

202609.how_measured: The 272 objects under the same prefix whose keys end in --sha256-<content hash>.zip, collected 2026-09-27. Each ZIP's central directory was read by ranged request with the reader key (no download) for the .shp member name (LSMD_CONT_LDREG_<code>_<yyyymm>) and member timestamps; the content hash in each key equals the checksum catalog.bronze_object holds for it (272 of 272). The provider page listed the same edition then: 기준일 2026-09, 갱신일 2026-09-15 (2026-09-16 for one file). extracted_on spans every member's date, 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-16 (root ADR-0148 context): earliest was first written as the oldest file's newest member (2026-09-14), which would call an edition wholly after a change some of its members predate.
